title: Seeking Tranquility
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Brand New Construction - Easy Beach Access - Private Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $40 per day from October 1 - May 1) - Covered Outdoor Grill/Dining Area - 6 seater Golf Cart & 6 Adult Bikes - Elevator Welcome to your perfect coastal escape in the peaceful community of Dune Allen Beach along scenic 30A. This brand new construction home blends elevated design with relaxed beachside living, offering everything you need for an unforgettable stay. Inside, the thoughtfully designed kitchen is a standout feature, complete with a spacious butler’s pantry for effortless entertaining and a convenient wet bar perfect for preparing cocktails or keeping drinks chilled after a day in the sun. Whether you're hosting a family dinner or a casual gathering, this space is both functional and stylish. Step outside to your own private oasis, where a sparkling pool invites you to cool off and unwind. The covered outdoor grill and dining area make it easy to enjoy al fresco meals, from fresh seafood dinners to laid-back lunches between beach trips. With easy beach access just moments away, you can spend your days soaking up the sugar-white sands and emerald waters that make 30A so special. Explore the area with ease using the included 6-seater golf cart and six adult bikes, perfect for cruising to nearby shops, dining, and local favorites. Designed for comfort, convenience, and coastal luxury, this home is the ideal retreat for your next 30A getaway. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor - 1/2 Bathroom Second Floor - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only Third Floor - Master King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Separate - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - King Bedroom w/ Shared Bathroom, Shower Only - Two Twin over Twin Bunkroom w/ Shared Bathroom, Shower Only
